breakdown.description: The flow is labeled inviscid but viscous shear stress is computed using viscosity.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification retains the contradictory 'inviscid' label while simultaneously using viscosity (mu=0.1 Pa·s) and the viscous shear stress formula tau = mu du/dy. It does not resolve the inconsistency as the ground truth does—neither by relabeling the flow as viscous nor by noting that inviscid flow would have zero shear stress making mu irrelevant.
